hooks.name: Contrarian Take
hooks.template: Everyone says {common advice}. After {specific experience}, I think that is wrong.

hooks.name: Number Reveal
hooks.template: I {did thing} for {N} {days/weeks}. Here is what actually happened.

hooks.name: Mistake Confession
hooks.template: {Specific cost} is what {one mistake} cost me.
hooks.best_for: A real lesson learned the hard way.

hooks.name: Before / After
hooks.template: {Time ago} I was {low state}. Today I {high state}. The difference was {one thing}.
hooks.trap: Listing several causes instead of one lever.

hooks.name: The List Promise
hooks.template: {N} things I wish someone had told me before {milestone}.
hooks.trap: Promising more items than can be delivered well.

hooks.name: Insider Secret
hooks.template: After {N} years {doing thing}, here is the part nobody puts in the {job posting/course/pitch}.
hooks.best_for: Real experience with a less-discussed detail.

hooks.name: The Callout
hooks.template: If you are still {outdated practice}, consider {specific change}.

hooks.name: Question Trap
hooks.template: {Specific scenario with a real cost}. What would you do?
hooks.best_for: A genuine decision with reasonable tradeoffs.
hooks.trap: Asking a question with an obvious answer.

hooks.name: Story Cold Open
hooks.template:
"{Real line of dialogue}"

{Who said it, when, and why it mattered}.

hooks.name: The Receipt
hooks.template: {Verifiable number or artifact}. {One sentence of context}.
hooks.trap: A number without context or proof.

hooks.name: Myth Bust
hooks.template: {Popular explanation} is not why {bad outcome} is happening.
hooks.best_for: Replacing a mistaken explanation with a useful one.

hooks.name: The Comparison
hooks.template: {Option A} vs {Option B}. {Surprising but fair verdict}.

hooks.name: Permission Slip
hooks.template: You are allowed to {specific thing the reader feels guilty about}.

hooks.name: Pattern Interrupt
hooks.template: {Short, true line}.
hooks.best_for: A striking fact or moment that the post can substantiate.
hooks.trap: Using drama unsupported by the story.

hooks.name: The Warning
hooks.template: {Common practice} may be costing you {specific thing}.
hooks.best_for: A real risk paired with a useful fix.
hooks.trap: Creating fear without offering a practical next step.

hooks.name: Good vs Great
hooks.template: Good {role} {action X}. Great {role} {meaningfully different action Y}.

hooks.name: Time Anchor
hooks.template: {Task} used to take me {long time}. It now takes {short time}.

hooks.name: The Unpopular Rule
hooks.template: I do not {widely accepted practice}. Here is why.
hooks.trap: Claiming a rule the author regularly breaks.

hooks.name: Curiosity Gap
hooks.template: The {superlative} {thing} I ever {verb} {unexpected detail}.
hooks.best_for: A story with an early payoff.

hooks.name: The Walk-Away
hooks.template: I {quit/cancelled/deleted} {valuable thing}. {Real result and cost}.

hooks.name: The Direct Value
hooks.template: Here is the exact {artifact} I used to {specific outcome}.
hooks.best_for: Sharing a useful resource or process.
hooks.trap: Promising an artifact or result the post does not include.
